sql: SELECT 'F' k, f.market_ticker t, f.side||'/'||f.action s, f.price::text p, f.quantity::text q, f.filled_at::text at FROM fills f JOIN live_orders o ON o.kalshi_order_id=f.kalshi_order_id WHERE o.strategy='Alimm1' AND f.filled_at > now()-interval '2 hours 5 minutes' UNION ALL SELECT 'O', market_ticker, side||'/'||action||'/'||status, limit_price::text, quantity::text, coalesce(cancel_reason,'')||' '||created_at::text FROM live_orders WHERE strategy='Alimm1' AND (status='resting' OR created_at > now()-interval '2 hours 5 minutes') AND coalesce(cancel_reason,'') NOT IN ('resting_sell:repriced','409_already_exists') UNION ALL SELECT 'B', '', '', '', residual_cents::text, at::text FROM incentive_balance_observations WHERE residual_cents<>0 AND at > now()-interval '2 hours 5 minutes' ORDER BY 1,2
